resources.string: A floating mic beside any keyboard: tap it, talk, and your words are typed where your cursor is. Offline.

ThumbFree bubble shows a small mic next to your keyboard when you type in other apps. Tap it and speak, and ThumbFree types what you said into the text box you are in.

This access is used only to find the focused text box and put your dictation there. ThumbFree does not read, store or send anything else on your screen, and speech is recognised on this phone without the internet.

Leave the shortcut off.
